test_case.test_name: Parameterized Mellanox CX9 cable service and negotiated-link restoration
test_case.purpose: Verify one approved CX9 cable disconnect/reconnect restores correct endpoint pairing, seating/route and qualified negotiated link without physical or protocol errors.
required_package: CX9 cable identity and endpoint-port map
test_case.test_command: Capture labeled CX9 endpoints/route and read-only link/error baseline. Technician places both endpoints in approved service state, disconnects/reconnects the exact cable once via connector housings, verifies keying/latches/bend route and restores readiness. Collect unique photos and full endpoint/link-training/error/log evidence; do not repeat or reset/retrain.
test_case.expected_result: The exact cable is undamaged, correctly paired/keyed/latched/routed and returns the same endpoints with required negotiated link attributes and no prohibited errors/events.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when physical evidence and all signed endpoint/link/error criteria match. Damage, swap/misroute/mis-latch, missing endpoint, downgrade or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing runtime cable/map/procedure/oracle is BLOCKED before handling.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until cable/ports, both-endpoint service state, authorization and recovery are signed.
Qualified technician only; vendor ESD/power/latch/bend controls apply.
No force, cable-body pull, unapproved hot work, repeat, reset/retrain, log clearing or retry.
Stop on resistance, damage, mismatch, incomplete latch, missing/degraded link or errors.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and cable identity
Signed endpoint map, keying/latch/bend route and dual-end service procedure
Unique pre/during/post photos of both connectors and route
Pre/post endpoint identities, negotiated link/training and error/event counters
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on physical or link discrepancy. Leave endpoints in approved safe state and escalate; use only signed recovery, never a second reconnect or automatic retrain/reset.
